title: Street mages
summary: Mages who live and work in the urban underworld.

claims.text: An Awakened gang member may stay on the streets to settle territory and end turf killings, to turn a gang toward something useful, or just to protect friends.
Street people know nothing of magick but have their own ways of dealing with outsiders who threaten them, and a mage who relies on power and attitude alone soon finds trouble.
A street mage's Avatar often wears the city's face: a dragon or samurai for an Akashic who fights gangs, neon and data for a Virtual Adept, brick and oily reflections for a Hollow One.
